checks.effective_sample: pairs in the training set, and n (1 - r) / (1 + r) with r the lag-1 autocorrelation of the targets in date order, floored at 0
checks.leaf_size: floor-regime pairs divided by the leaf: 5 (the variants) and 20 (gbm_funding)
checks.reading: no threshold: the page reads the figures in words and says which explanation they support; a cause that needs a refit is declared first and goes to the Mac
checks.refits: every refit (every 21 scored days, 61 days of minimum history, as the walks) whose first scored day is in the window, at each lead 1 to 5
checks.sets: direct pairs of ml._direct_pairs through the lead's as-of rule on the direct variant's inputs; one-step pairs (p, p + 1) on the same training frame
checks.target_variance: variance of the targets, of target minus the spread at the pair's anchor, and of the floor-regime pairs' targets

decomposition.contrast: the same decomposition on target days outside 2021-23
cuts: target day type (ordinary, settlement, month_end, tax_date, quarter_end)
calendar year of the target day (the floor regime fills a refit's training window over 2021-23, see the training check's per-refit floor pairs)
decomposition.excess: candidate minus reference of the grid CRPS; positive is a loss of the candidate
decomposition.pairs_note: direct over gbm_funding differs in the pairing, the leaf (5 against 20) and the inputs (calendar and net-settlement columns added); aligned against direct differs in the pairing alone
decomposition.walks: #1036's: gbm_funding (#634's), gbm_funding_cal_direct and gbm_funding_cal_aligned, five leads each, read as they are; nothing is refitted
